task.title: To remove the Microsoft application cache
task.shortdesc: After this open Microsoft Word and open the X-Author Contracts Add-in.

step.cmd: Go to Menu Bar > Go > Go to Folder.
In the go to Folder dialog box enter the following path and click Go: ~/Library/Containers/com.Microsoft.Word/data/Library/Caches/
In the Caches folder, select the folders starting with ‘com.microsoft..’
Right-click on the selected folder name and select Move to Trash.

result.p: After this open Microsoft Word and open the X-Author Contracts Add-in.
